# EverBloom Studio

> Preserved botanicals and handcrafted goods, designed in Brooklyn, New York. The online shop is opening soon.

EverBloom Studio LLC was founded in New York in 2026. The studio makes preserved botanicals, handcrafted leather goods, ceramic mini vases, cross-stitch embroidery, vintage map prints, and custom city map posters. Finished goods come from small workshops and are tested in Brooklyn before they are listed for sale. Preserved botanicals come from a partner workshop in Lingyuan, Liaoning.

Wholesale inquiries are open for the preserved botanical line. Leather, ceramic, and cross-stitch lines open to retail partners as testing completes.

- Website: https://everbloomstudio.us/
- Email: info@everbloomstudio.us
- Location: Brooklyn, New York
